:::{#def-prediction-rmse}
#### Root mean squared error of predictions

The **root mean squared error** (RMSE) of predictions
$\fitted_1, \ldots, \fitted_n$
of observed outcomes $y_1, \ldots, y_n$
is the square root of their [mean squared error](estimation.qmd#def-prediction-mse):

$$
\rmselr{\fitted} \eqdef \sqrt{\mselr{\fitted}}.
$$ {#eq-prediction-rmse}

:::
